hypotheses.E1_anchored20_improves_tail_pca: The primary raw-4-anchored exact-KL rank-20 fit lowers held-out median KL by at least 20% relative to raw-4 plus PCA tail-16 on every corpus.
hypotheses.E2_global20_improves_natural_pca: The primary global exact-KL rank-20 fit lowers held-out median KL by at least 20% relative to natural PCA rank 20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.E3_rank68_reaches_near_sufficiency: At least one exact-KL rank-68 fit reaches median KL at most 0.02 on every corpus.
hypotheses.E4_rank20_solutions_are_seed_stable: The two independently optimized rank-20 spaces have mean canonical cosine at least 0.80 for both global and anchored fits.
hypotheses.E5_improvement_replicates_across_seeds: Both rank-20 seeds beat their corresponding PCA baseline on every corpus.
hypotheses.E6_weight_anchor_is_not_costly: The primary anchored rank-20 fit has no more than 10% higher median KL than the primary global rank-20 fit on every corpus.
hypotheses.E7_behavioral_fit_is_not_just_more_varia: At least one corpus has a behavior-optimized rank-20 basis with lower variance capture but lower median KL than its PCA baseline.
